in_english.name: Zulaikhaat
in_english.long_meaning: Zulaikhaat is a feminine name that means 'beautiful woman' or 'lovely woman'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'z-l-kh', which connotes beauty and attraction. The name is mentioned in the Quran as a symbol of beauty and temptation, particularly in the story of Prophet Yusuf. In Islamic tradition, the name Zulaikhaat carries deep spiritual significance, reflecting the qualities of beauty, charm, and allure
